name: soleon
description: Connects Claude Code to Soleon. One plugin for everyone: it requests consent for the whole Soleon surface, and the server decides what you can actually see and do from your real Soleon permissions — the tools you are not allowed to use are never listed, and a call to one is refused. Ships one-job skills for reading, changing, testing and releasing agents; create-agent, which interviews you about a new agent and creates, configures and deploys it on dev with approval on every change; deploy-agent, which converts a local Claude Code agent identity (.claude/agents/<name>.md) into a validated, deploy-ready agent via an Allium specification; pull-agent, its reverse arrow, which pulls a Soleon agent into Claude Code as a local subagent whose tools run on the platform and whose every file save lands on your draft, plus run-local-eval to score it with the platform's own judge prompt; write-evals, for evals whose score reflects the behaviour under test; and write-skill-scripts, for the Python an agent runs from its skills.
